Engagement Models

Choose the Model That Matches Your Delivery Need

Different goals need different models. We structure each engagement around speed, ownership, budget, and control.

Staff Augmentation

Add skilled engineers to your existing team. Best when you already have product or engineering leadership and need senior talent quickly.

What you get:

  • Senior engineers
  • Fast onboarding
  • Works within your processes
  • Direct collaboration
  • Flexible scaling
  • Monthly engagement
  • Replacement support

Dedicated Delivery Team

Build Your Team

Fixed Price

Use a milestone-based model when scope, timeline, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined. Best for projects with defined deliverables and a clear launch target.

What you get:

  • Predictable timelines

  • Clear governance
  • Defined acceptance
  • Structured handover
  • Clear commercial visibility

Questions Clients Ask Before Starting a Project

We partner with SMEs, and global enterprises looking to build new digital products, modernize legacy applications, adopt AI, migrate to the cloud, or extend their engineering capabilities. Our engagement models are tailored to your business goals, team structure, and delivery requirements.


We combine the flexibility of a specialist engineering partner with the governance of a publicly listed company, backed by 600+ in-house professionals and 14+ years of delivery experience.

Yes. Our Cloud, Data & DevOps team specializes in legacy modernization, cloud migration, and building scalable infrastructure for modern software delivery.

We provide both. Our AI Systems & Automation practice builds AI agents, generative AI applications, RAG systems, and LLM integrations, working alongside our traditional product engineering teams so AI capabilities fit cleanly into your existing systems.


Yes. We're a Salesforce consulting partner offering implementation, customization, integration, and support services, helping businesses configure Salesforce to fit their exact workflows and get more value from their CRM.


It depends on your goals. Choose Staff Augmentation if you need to hire fast, a Dedicated Delivery Team if you want us to own execution end-to-end, or Fixed Price if your scope and timeline are already defined.
